paras: Bazzalan commands the Searing Blade cult from the lava caverns beneath Orgrimmar. Alongside Jergosh the Invoker, he directs its work in Ragefire Chasm.

Beneath Orgrimmar, Bazzalan has joined the Searing Blade cult in Ragefire Chasm. While Thrall works to establish the Orcs' new home across Durotar, the satyr rogue commands the cult's field forces from winding lava caverns. He is swift and lethal with twin blades.

From a volcanic ledge above the central chamber, Bazzalan oversees the cultist guards. Jergosh the Invoker conducts demonic rituals below. Like all satyrs, Bazzalan's ultimate loyalty belongs to demonic masters. He uses poison, quick strikes, and stealth against Horde scouts who venture near the cult's staging ground.
